text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English \"Strategic Management Support Section\" focuses on drafting reports and crisis management, while Italian \"Sezione Aiuto alla condotta strategica\" additionally includes managing and developing the Federal Administration's Corporate Design.", "type": "addition", "tgt": {"quote": "gestire e sviluppare - dal punto di vista strategico e operativo - il Corporate Design dell'Amministrazione federale (CD Bund)", "before": "È anche responsabile di"}, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "English \"Communication Support Section\" describes advising and supporting the Federal Administration on all communication matters and creating a wide range of communication products, while Italian \"Sezione di sostegno in materia di comunicazione\" only mentions managing and developing the Corporate Design.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "The section advises and supports the Federal Administration in all matters relating to communication and creates a wide range of communication products.", "before": "Communication Support Section"}, "severity": 0.8}]}
